name: Excess
overview: Scripture warns against excess in various forms, highlighting the dangers of overindulgence and covetousness. Proverbs cautions that too much of even a good thing, like honey or wine, leads to harm and folly, while Luke reminds believers that life’s value is not found in material abundance. Paul exhorts Christians to reject worldly patterns and avoid the excesses of the flesh, such as drunkenness, urging instead to be filled with the Spirit and renewed in mind to discern God's perfect will.
